ReleaseNotes: This maintenance release improves the release publishing workflow.
* Added post-release source repository finalization to VBoxTrayReleasePublisher.
- Offers to finalize the source repository after a successful release publication.
- Suggests the release commit message, annotated tag name, and tag message.
- Verifies the source repository state before committing.
- Pushes the source branch and release tag together.
- Allows returning directly to the Publisher main menu without modifying the source repository.
